scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on their account and requesting a refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Wei Li and I'm 45. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Hello Wei. I can certainly look into that charge for you. To get started, could you please provide the transaction ID or the exact merchant name listed on your statement?
The merchant is listed as 'Global Tech Solutions' and the date was October 12th.
Thank you. For security purposes, can you please confirm the last four digits of the card used and your billing zip code?
Sure, it's 4492 and the zip code is 90210.

Thanks. I see the charge here. I'm checking our system... it looks like a standard merchant transaction. Since I can't immediately identify this as a known fraud pattern, I'll need to open a formal dispute. Per our standard terms, this will initiate an investigation.
Wait, so I have to wait for an investigation? Can't you just reverse it now?

I understand the frustration, but I need to follow the protocol for unauthorized transactions. I have officially opened the dispute case number #88291. You should see a provisional credit for the $76 applied to your account within 24 hours while the investigation proceeds.

resolution_summary: Agent opened a formal dispute case and confirmed a provisional credit would be applied to the customer's account within 24 hours.
